text:
Can you name all 10 branches of the internal carotid artery? 🧠 Just remember: A VIP's COMMA
Internal carotid artery branches mnemonic: A VIP's COMMA = 10 branches
A = Anterior choroidal
V = Vidian artery
I = Inferolateral trunk
P = Posterior communicating
S = Superior hypophyseal
C = Caroticotympanic
O = Ophthalmic
M = Meningohypophyseal trunk
M = Middle cerebral
A = Anterior cerebral
Quick test: which two branches are the end of the artery? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Figs. 513 and 519, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume

Internal carotid branches cheat sheet 🧠 A VIP's COMMA — swipe →
A = Anterior choroidal
V = Vidian artery
I = Inferolateral trunk
P = Posterior communicating
S = Superior hypophyseal
C = Caroticotympanic
O = Ophthalmic
M = Meningohypophyseal trunk
M = Middle cerebral
A = Anterior cerebral
Terminal branches: middle + anterior cerebral. Segments: C2 Vidian + caroticotympanic, C4 inferolateral + meningohypophyseal, C6 superior hypophyseal + ophthalmic, C7 anterior choroidal + posterior communicating.
Save this for your next anatomy exam 📌
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 519, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
